title: Resolution to set hearing on raising BID spending caps
summary: This resolution schedules a public hearing for November 19, 2026 at City Hall on a bill that would raise the annual spending limits for eight business improvement districts, including 34th Street, East Mid-Manhattan and West Village. The increases, requested by the districts themselves, would take effect July 1, 2027 and range from $354,450 to $16.3 million depending on the district. Higher spending limits would lead to higher assessments on properties within these districts.
